name: fs-mcp-server
description: Servidor MCP de FacturaScripts con soporte multi-conexión

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=dist/index.js --log-level=warning "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs build/*/*.test.js
